sources.quote: US AI data centers projected to become the fifth-largest natural gas consumer in the world by 2035
US data centers could consume more natural gas than Germany and Japan combined by 2035

claims.statement: US data centers are projected to be among the world's largest natural gas consumers by 2035.

sources.quote: 15 billion cubic feet per day are needed to keep data centers running by 2035

claims.statement: The projected requirement is 15 billion cubic feet per day.

discrepancies.explanation: One outlet quantifies the projection as a world rank and a daily volume; the other states it as a comparison with two countries and gives no figure.

quotes.quote: 15 billion cubic feet per day are needed to keep data centers running by 2035
The AI frenzy could push U.S. data centers to become one of the largest consumers of natural gas in the world.

headline: US data centers projected as major natural gas consumer by 2035
summary: Two outlets report the same projection that US data centers will be among the world's largest consumers of natural gas by 2035. One gives a rank and a daily volume; the other compares the total to Germany and Japan combined. Neither text names the source of the estimate.
